ogent Makefile targets:

  make all          - Run all lints and tests
  make lint         - Run all linters (checkdoc, compile, package-lint)
  make test         - Run all tests
  make test-build-report - Verify machine reports against real compiler/ERT fixtures
  make test-isolation - Verify the suite never writes real user stores
  make offline-test - Replay workflows with real dependencies (OGENT_ELPA_DIR required)
  make compile      - Byte-compile source files
  make recompile    - Clean and compile; failures remain nonzero
  make clean        - Remove generated lisp/ and test/ bytecode
  make bench        - Run performance benchmarks
  make batch        - Run Emacs in batch mode with project loaded
  make interactive  - Run Emacs interactively with project loaded
  make sandbox      - Run interactive Emacs in clean sandbox
  make sandbox-test - Run tests in clean sandbox environment
  make sandbox-lint - Run all linters in clean sandbox
  make demo         - Launch demo.org in minimal Emacs

Options (pass as var=val):
  v=1|2|3           - Verbosity level (-v, -vv, -vvv)
  sandbox=1|DIR     - Run in sandbox mode
  install-deps=1    - Auto-install package dependencies
  install-linters=1 - Auto-install linting tools
  debug=1           - Enable debug mode
  EMACS=PATH        - Select the Emacs executable for every target
  format=json       - Versioned report for makem-backed targets; diagnostics on stderr
  NO_COLOR=1        - Disable color (nonterminal stderr is already plain)

Examples:
  make test v=2                    - Run tests with verbose output
  make lint sandbox=1              - Lint in clean sandbox
  make all sandbox=1 install-deps=1 - Full CI-like run
  make test format=json            - Actual ERT run with structured results
  ./makem.sh --capabilities --json  - Discover tasks and exit codes without Emacs

Additional makem.sh rules (use make <rule>):
  lint-checkdoc, lint-compile, lint-declare, lint-indent,
  lint-package, lint-regexps, test-ert, test-buttercup

Agent discovery (after loading ogent; no provider requests):
  (ogent-agent-capabilities 'json) - Live tool contracts and approval policy
  (ogent-agent-guide)             - Paste-ready SDK handbook
  (ogent-agent-triage 'json)       - Discovery plus local health and next actions
  (ogent-doctor-batch nil 'json)   - JSON health; exit 0 ok/info, 1 warning, 2 error
